## Flagship Projects
- [NaviCampus](https://navicampus.app/): Climate-aware and step-free accessible multi-floor campus navigation engine built for UAE university campuses under extreme desert heat. Features a "Coolest Route" algorithm through air-conditioned skywalks and shaded concourses, plus an in-browser vector topology compiler for zero-latency pathfinding.
- [Blackboarder](https://blackboarder.pages.dev/) ([Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kciflchaejgedgjookkmnkgjhbhhabjb) · [GitHub](https://github.com/yvs1n/blackboarder-extension)): Bilingual (Arabic + English) Manifest V3 Chrome extension and companion PWA for Blackboard Learn Ultra. Includes a local NLP parser for extracting exam deadlines and room changes, weighted UOS 4.0 GPA projections, cross-device sync via 10-character keys, and 528+ Vitest automated tests.
- [Elementa](https://elementaa.vercel.app/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/yvs1n/elementa)): Full-stack educational science learning platform with real-time student progress tracking and video walkthroughs.
- [TranZ](https://tranz.pages.dev/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/yvs1n/tranz)): National finalist project built for CodeX UAE.
- [FundFair](https://fundfair.pages.dev/) & [SSFIM](https://ssfim.pages.dev/): Startup and sustainability showcases (SSFIM presented to Ranju Anand, SVP of Education at GEMS Education).
